title: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave Is Getting New Stories
summary:
Players of the video game Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave have a surprise. Nintendo and the game studio Intelligent Systems announced an expansion pass this week. It adds extra content to the game in three waves.

The game came out in September 2026. The gaming website Polygon says it sold well and got great reviews.

The first wave adds four new weapons. They are based on weapons from an older game, Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

The second wave should come during the 2026 holidays. It adds new outfits and three powerful characters, the Dagdan gods.

The third wave is expected in 2027. It adds four new story paths, called routes, about four rival lords.

The studio once said the game first had eight main characters, but the team cut it to four. Many fans wanted the missing stories back, and now they are coming.
why_it_matters: If you play Fire Emblem, you will get new weapons, outfits and stories to explore.
